summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Direxion Daily Pharmaceutical & Medical Bull 3X ETF (PILL) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Pharmaceuticals Select Industry index. The fund provides 3x daily exposure to a modified equal-weighted index of pharmaceutical companies in the US. PILL was launched on Nov 15, 2017 and is issued by Direxion.

holdings.infoBox: PILL is an equity ETF with a total of 68 individual holdings. The top holdings are SPSIPH SWAP ASSET LEG stock at 225.29%, GOLDMAN FINL SQ TRSRY INST 506 at 22.88%, DREYFUS GOVT CASH MAN INS at 3.93%, Xeris Biopharma Holdings at 1.85%, and Amneal Pharmaceuticals at 1.72%.
